material_systems.name: DTM Acrylic Primer for Ferrous Metal Repaint
material_systems.notes: Standard primer for ferrous metals. Spot prime on sound paint (bare areas only). Full prime after rust treatment or strip. UV stable, flexible, flash-rust resistant. Water-based cleanup. Coverage 350-450 SF/gal on RP surfaces (rougher profile than NC).

material_systems.name: DTM Alkyd Primer for Pitted Ferrous Metal Repaint
material_systems.notes: Superior wetting for pitted surfaces. Oil-based — solvent cleanup. Better corrosion inhibition than acrylic. BLOCKED on galvanized (saponification) and aluminum. QT2 excluded — economy tier uses acrylic DTM only.

material_systems.name: Etch Primer for Non-Ferrous Metal Repaint
material_systems.notes: Phosphoric acid-based primer for bare/exposed non-ferrous surfaces. Creates iron phosphate conversion on galvanized. Required when existing coating is removed exposing bare non-ferrous metal.

material_systems.name: Acrylic Bonding Primer for Sound Existing Non-Ferrous
material_systems.notes: Adhesion bridge between existing coating and new topcoat on non-ferrous metal. Used on sound existing paint where etch primer is inappropriate (etch attacks existing coatings). Spot application on deglosed areas.

material_systems.name: DTM Acrylic Exterior Finish for Metal Repaint
material_systems.notes: Universal DTM acrylic topcoat for all metal RP. 2 coats standard. UV stable, flexible, excellent color retention. Self-priming on sound existing paint. Gloss excluded for RP — substrate imperfections magnified at gloss level.

material_systems.name: Rust Converter Treatment
material_systems.notes: Converts Fe2O3 rust to stable iron phosphate. Applied after mechanical prep to residual rust. 24 hr cure before priming. Complementary treatment — not replacement for mechanical prep. Best for intricate profiles where power tools cannot reach.

compatibility_rules.title: Galvanized + oil/alkyd primer BLOCKED
compatibility_rules.rule: Oil-based and alkyd primers MUST NOT be applied to galvanized metal. Saponification destroys adhesion.

compatibility_rules.title: Structural rust is HARD STOP
compatibility_rules.rule: Structural rust (section loss, perforation, structural compromise) is a HARD STOP. Structural assessment and metalwork repair required before painting.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: TSK_MTRP_STRUCTURAL_RUST_CHECK gate task. If structural rust detected, STOP WORK.

compatibility_rules.title: SP1 solvent clean mandatory on ALL metal
compatibility_rules.rule: SSPC-SP1 solvent cleaning is the mandatory first step for ALL metal substrates regardless of condition.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: TSK_MTRP_SP1_SOLVENT_CLEAN is always-active. Cannot be skipped.

compatibility_rules.title: Galvanized/aluminum require etch or bonding primer
compatibility_rules.rule: Non-ferrous metals require etch primer (bare/exposed) or bonding primer (sound existing). Standard DTM primers blocked.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: Primer routing: galvanized/aluminum -> SYS_EXT_MTRP_PRIMER_ETCH (bare) or SYS_EXT_MTRP_PRIMER_BONDING (sound existing).

compatibility_rules.title: No roll application method
compatibility_rules.rule: Rollers are ineffective on metal profiles. Brush and spray only.

compatibility_rules.title: Rust converter — ferrous metals only
compatibility_rules.rule: Rust converter is only applicable to ferrous metals (carbon steel, wrought iron). Aluminum and galvanized do not rust — they corrode differently.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: SYS_EXT_MTRP_RUST_CONVERTER blocked when substrate_type = aluminum or galvanized.

compatibility_rules.title: Gloss sheen excluded for RP
compatibility_rules.rule: Gloss sheen requires substrate perfection not achievable over existing paint. Satin and semi-gloss only.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: Sheen enum restricted to satin and semi-gloss.

compatibility_rules.title: Modifier stacking cap 4.0x
compatibility_rules.rule: Ornate (2.25) x scaffold (1.60) x QT4 (1.15) = 4.14x exceeds cap. Flag for estimator review.
